key_path: API key: dashboard.render.com/u/settings#api-keys > create key (account-wide, non-expiring), set RENDER_API_KEY. Or `render login`: browser 'Authorize CLI' generates an expiring CLI token
MCP: Render plugin for Claude Code/Codex/Cursor (OAuth), or `claude mcp add --transport http render https://mcp.render.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_KEY"`
human_gates: credit_card effectively needed to keep Free services alive past limits (Free services suspend / builds disabled without a payment method)

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes-ish: `render login` opens the dashboard 'Authorize CLI' page and saves a CLI token (browser confirm, not a device code)
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: no: AS metadata at api.render.com has no registration_endpoint, so OAuth works only for pre-registered clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, Pi per agents.md)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no API to mint keys. REST API (OpenAPI) for resources only
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: no: API keys grant access to all workspaces of the user and do not expire
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes (Free instances; payment method needed to avoid suspension at limits)

remote.auth: OAuth (pre-registered clients) or API key bearer

mcp.type: product (services, deploys, env vars, Postgres queries, logs, metrics)
mcp.one_click: official plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; Claude Desktop connector

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://render.com/llms.txt (routing: setup goes to agents.md, tasks go to agents/tasks.md)
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: https://render.com/agents.md (idempotent setup procedure plus per-agent setup contracts); public docs search API https://render.com/api/agent/docs-search?query=; skills index https://render.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

score_justification: Agent docs are top-tier (agents.md procedure, docs-search API, skills well-known index), but there is no anonymous or claim path, no DCR, no scoped keys and no API to mint keys.
best_practice: agents.md tells the agent to keep working while waiting for the human ('Do not stop working while you wait'), references secrets only by env-var name, and explains the OAuth-expiry vs API-key trade-off
biggest_gap: Unscoped, non-expiring, account-wide API keys created only in the dashboard, plus no DCR, mean a human must copy a god-mode key for any non-blessed agent
